queries.title: Search Queries
queries.description: Job titles or keywords to search for (e.g. ['AI Automation', 'Python Developer', 'Data Analyst'])

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Locations to search, one pass each. Use countries/cities (e.g. ['Nigeria', 'Africa']) — LinkedIn's guest API ignores 'Worldwide' and returns city-locked cards instead.

location.title: Location (legacy)
location.description: Single location used only when `locations` is empty. 'Worldwide' is ignored by LinkedIn.

remoteOnly.title: Remote Only
remoteOnly.description: Filter strictly for remote job opportunities

maxJobs.title: Max Jobs to Scrape
maxJobs.description: Maximum total jobs to extract across all queries

fetchDetails.title: Fetch Full Job Descriptions
fetchDetails.description: Whether to fetch the complete job description, requirements, and hiring criteria for each listing

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Select proxies to use. For heavy volume, enable Apify Proxy.
